verdict.rationale: Google Workspace documents its own automatic user provisioning: changes to Workspace user accounts sync automatically to a third-party app (the Office 365 provisioning guide), so accounts are pushed downstream. The evidence does not name SCIM, and covers only one connector page. missing for 10: explicit SCIM protocol support, group and entitlement push, evidence of provisioning triggered when access is assigned, breadth across downstream apps, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, accounts create themselves — SCIM provisioning pushes users, groups, and entitlements into downstream apps the moment access is assigned

citations.quote: Puedes configurar el aprovisionamiento automático de usuarios para que los cambios que realices en las cuentas de usuario de Google Workspace se sincronicen automáticamente con esta app de terceros.
אתם יכולים להגדיר הקצאת הרשאות אוטומטית למשתמשים כדי שכל השינויים שתבצעו בחשבונות המשתמשים ב-Google Workspace יסונכרנו אוטומטית עם אפליקציית הצד השלישי הזאת.
